messages.text: Doesn't matter. Look outside your window.
Stop joking. I'm calling the police.
The police won't reach here in time.

messages.content: A loud thud echoes from the hallway.

messages.text: I told you. You shouldn't have opened the door for that delivery earlier.
How did you know about the delivery??
I was the one who handed you the bag.
No... the guy had a mask on. And he didn't say anything.
Check the bag again. Look at the bottom.

messages.content: You walk slowly to the kitchen. The paper bag is still on the counter.

messages.text: It's a picture of me... sleeping... in this room.
You look so peaceful when you're not scared.
I'm locking the bedroom door. The police are on their way.
The lock won't help. I'm already inside the closet.
